title: Concept: Swift package ranged to a whole major version
description: Package.swift declares a range whose upper bound is a whole major release, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a range whose upper bound is a whole major release.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Package.swift (swift).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a range whose upper bound is a whole major release.
